scope.units: decimal returns/risk fractions, wealth starts at100
scope.quantiles: linear interpolation for descriptive quantiles; explicitly suffixed inverted_cdf P10/P90 are empirical inverse-CDF alternatives for chance-constraint consistency; median uses np.median
scope.purpose: development-only structural diagnostics; no new menu or learned policy selected; V1 unchanged

annual_sample_description.mixture_weight: 1/120 for a scenario, then 1/30 for a year within it
annual_sample_description.annual_quantiles_and_correlations: descriptive weighted mixture; no binomial or iid-row certification
annual_sample_description.bootstrap: percentile intervals from 2000 whole-scenario resamples; descriptive sampling variability under the supplied independent-scenario model, not predictive calibration

contemporaneous_high_inflation.definition: contemporaneous pooled annual inflation >= development P75; descriptive, not a forecast

serial_dependence.variables: asset log real gross and raw inflation; no pairs cross scenario boundaries
serial_dependence.small_sample_caveat: 30-year per-path correlations are noisy and demeaning can bias short-path autocorrelations; these summaries do not establish exploitable prediction

between_scenario_structure.independence: asserted by the problem statement, not proved by descriptive correlations
between_scenario_structure.scenario_specific_summary_distributions: see per-asset means and loss fractions above
between_scenario_structure.interpretation: scenario IDs are labels, not market dates; this is an order diagnostic, not evidence for independence or a cross-market forecast

all_bills.execution: annually restored fixed target, fee after target weights; initial allocation charged, no terminal liquidation

equal_weight_annual.execution: annually restored fixed target, fee after target weights; initial allocation charged, no terminal liquidation

identifiability.reason: High/Medium/Low are ordinal. The questionnaire supplies no required amount, access date, withdrawal schedule, external reserve, or permitted liquidation loss. Market returns cannot identify those preferences.
identifiability.market_liquidity_vs_reserve: The contest supplies no asset-specific settlement delay, sale-capacity or liquidity penalty. Assets can be transferred at the common fee at annual reviews. A bill floor is a declared reserve/market-risk buffer proxy, not a measured marketability requirement.
identifiability.main_experiment: No deposits or withdrawals, as required by the problem. Potential-spending scenarios below are supplemental interpretation only.
identifiability.low_does_not_imply_zero: A Low label does not prove that required reserves equal zero.

questions_to_clarify: How much purchasing power could be needed?
When and how quickly could it be needed?
Are there reserves outside this account?
What liquidation loss or delay is acceptable?

possible_predeclared_policy_cases_not_re.ordinal_floor_approach: Declare several monotone floor triplets before testing; treat .30/.10/0 as one unsupported policy case, not a calibrated baseline or a regulatory rule.
possible_predeclared_policy_cases_not_re.reserve_coverage_approach: Declare annual potential need q and coverage years K=1 or2; derive b from an explicit bill-accumulation/liability convention. Do not assign q to High/Medium/Low without elicitation or an openly labelled assumption.
possible_predeclared_policy_cases_not_re.zero_real_return_examples: .30 corresponds to one year at q=.30 or two years at q=.15; .10 corresponds to one year at q=.10 or two years at q=.05. These interpretations are assumptions, not facts about the five clients.
possible_predeclared_policy_cases_not_re.immediate_need: A known immediate need fraction q requires at least q available before earning returns; it is different from the year-end payment examples.
possible_predeclared_policy_cases_not_re.no_costless_safety_claim: Higher bill reserves can sacrifice growth and still lose purchasing power; they do not solve inflation risk.

1.interpretation: initial reserve fraction b=q*sum_{j=1}^K(1/B_j), where B_j is cumulative real bill gross and each year-end payment is q times initial real wealth

2.interpretation: initial reserve fraction b=q*sum_{j=1}^K(1/B_j), where B_j is cumulative real bill gross and each year-end payment is q times initial real wealth

liquidity_assumptions.example_limitations: Uses first1or2 years of 120 original scenarios. q, K, payment timing and P90/P95 reserve quantile are extra assumptions. Empirical reserve quantiles are not independently certified coverage and are not client preferences. No spending, fees on withdrawals, income or external resources are supplied; these examples must not replace the contest no-withdrawal paths.

primary_sources.title: 2026 MCM Senior Group Problem A
primary_sources.supports: Only horizon, loss tolerance and ordinal liquidity are supplied; no later deposits or withdrawals are allowed.

primary_sources.title: SEC Investor.gov: Investment Products
primary_sources.supports: Liquidity concerns ease and cost of converting investments into usable money; product choice also depends on goals, timeframe and risk tolerance.
primary_sources.does_not_support: Any .30/.10/0 floor, liability fraction or probability guarantee.

primary_sources.title: FINRA: Suitability Considerations and Sales Practices for Senior Investors, 2016 conference materials, reproduction of Notice11-25
primary_sources.supports: Conceptual liquidity needs include obligations, speed, amount and conversion losses/costs.
primary_sources.does_not_support: A current regulatory conclusion or a mandated allocation for this academic contest.

interpretation_limits: All probabilities describe the supplied synthetic development distribution, not guaranteed future markets.
3600 annual rows are not independent trials; the original scenario is the sampling unit.
Nominal annual returns and real gross/return summaries exclude portfolio fees; diagnostic portfolio paths include fees consistently.
Serial structure and contemporaneous correlation do not prove forecast usefulness or identify a causal inflation mechanism.
Annual observations omit intrayear drawdowns and transaction timing detail.
No parameters or products may be justified by old final outcomes or a desired client mapping.
